name: Compose a clear subject
short_description: Make three images in which an intended subject is visually distinct from its surroundings.
self_assessment: I can compose three images with one clear subject in each without help.
description: Make three images in which an intended subject is visually distinct from its surroundings. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Photograph one object from three viewpoints
